description: This file defines React components for various UI states (loading, empty, error) used in a front-end application, along with a generic 'StateBox' component for consistent styling.

methods.name: StateBox
methods.description: A reusable UI component that displays a styled box with a title, optional description, and optional actions.

methods.name: LoadingState
methods.description: A component that displays a loading indicator with a label.

methods.name: EmptyState
methods.description: A component that shows an empty state message with optional actions.

methods.name: ErrorState
methods.description: A component that displays an error message with optional retry action.
